name: 01-open
caption: Open the lab: today’s fishing picture for Jamaican waters, by area.

name: 02-plan
caption: Today’s plan: the best spot, the best time and the sea at that time.

name: 03-conf
caption: Tap the Picture badge to see how sure the map is in each area, and why.

name: 04-times
caption: Major and minor feeding times for the whole island. Only what’s coming up is shown.

name: 05-bank
caption: Tap a red dot for that bank’s wind, seas and current.

name: 06-layers
caption: Arrows show which way the current runs. Green marks are weed seen by satellite.

name: 07-create
caption: Captains create the boat code: boat name, your name and boat type. Crew join with it.

name: 08-share
caption: Only the captain picks who sees catches. Research, the default, never shares a spot.

name: 09-strike
caption: Hooked up? Tap Strike, tick what happened and add an approx weight. Needs your boat code and GPS.

name: 10-star
caption: Your strikes show as stars, with the weight. Logged by mistake? Delete it.

name: 11-track
caption: Track record: how often strikes landed in the map’s hot spots. Every log tests it.
